run_muzero_policy: run MuZero search with Dirichlet noise and PUCT action selection to propose actions
run_gumbel_muzero_policy: run Gumbel MuZero search with Sequential Halving and Gumbel noise for action selection
run_stochastic_muzero_policy: run Stochastic MuZero search with separate decision and chance recurrent functions
mask_invalid_actions: mask invalid actions in logits by setting them to minimum float values
add_dirichlet_noise: add Dirichlet noise to action probabilities for exploration during search
